A small shop.
name: shop
Notes.
"""The shop package."""

import argparse

from shop import core


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = ap.add_subparsers()
    sub.add_parser("bill")
    sub.add_parser("refund")
    core.bill(None)

export function total(items: number[]) { return items.length; }
export const TAX_RATE = 0.2;
